name: Vivaa Tradecom Limited
summary: Vivaa Tradecom Limited operates in the textile and apparel sector, handling both the production and commercial exchange of clothing items. The company's main trading activities center on denim fabric and ready-to-wear apparel, specifically denim and cotton jeans designed for both men and women. Furthermore, it offers specialized cotton printing services and also trades in printed cotton fabrics. This enterprise was established in 1995 and has its principal office located in Ahmedabad, India.
